The '''R-6000 blaster rifle''' was a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] produced by [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] during the era of the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. The [[Rifle/Legends|rifle]] was known to have been demonstrated to [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kresk]], leader of the [[Imperial Ordnance Acquisition Corps]], by Czerka's weapon division's chief operating officer [[Eva Kaayz]]. After its presentation, the Imperial Moff ordered sixty-thousand units.<ref name="SWTOR" />
